name: wellness: one fact on a band-crossing day by priority, none on an ordinary day
cell: rest / all sources / never started / base
comment: Baseline = mean of the metric's values on the 28 days before the day (the day itself excluded), null with fewer than 7 values.
HRV 50 ms, resting HR 55 bpm, daylight 45 min on every day 09-22..10-19. VO2 max 43.5 on 10-13 and 44.0 on 10-20 only.

10-20: HRV 38 <= 50 x (1 - 20/100) = 40 -> crossing (below); resting HR 61 >= 55 + 5 = 60 -> crossing (above); daylight 15 < 20 -> crossing (below). Priority hrv_ms, resting_hr, daylight_min -> the one fact is HRV. VO2 max baseline: 1 prior value < 7 -> null.
10-19 (ordinary): HRV 50 > 40, RHR 55 < 60, daylight 45 >= 20 -> wellness_fact null. Its HRV baseline is the 27 prior values (09-22..10-18) = 50.0.
09-28: 6 prior values (09-22..09-27) -> hrv_ms_baseline null, and no fact can fire without a baseline. 09-29: 7 prior values -> 50.0.
